name: Toulouse communications specialist seeking a fixed-term public-interest role

constraints: Clear recruitment process and required documents
context.company_awareness: Knows major local public institutions but fewer associations.

trigger: A search for public communications work returns civil-service guidance and expired PDF adverts instead of clearly applicable CDD openings.

searches_run.query: chargé communication CDD Toulouse association secteur public
searches_run.observation: Retrieved official public-service vacancies, association postings and older PDF adverts. Public and nonprofit results have different recruitment paths; a generic contract label cannot explain all conditions.

searches_run.query: offre emploi communication Toulouse contractuel CDD recrutement sans concours
searches_run.observation: Retrieved both official vacancy pages and general Toulouse application guidance. Direct university vacancy inspection showed CDD, contract-only recruitment, required documents and a deadline of 27 September 2026, already past on research date. Its duration text also conflicts with its October start.

sources.title: Chargé de communication digitale Toulouse Capitole | Choisir le service public
sources.supports: Direct page lists contract-only CDD, CV/letter and 27 September deadline; inconsistent contract-end text and elapsed deadline mean not a verified current opportunity.

sources.title: Chargé de Communication et d'Administration PSA31 | Toulouse Métropole emploi
sources.supports: Retrieved association CDD posting in Balma; actual current availability not checked.

sources.title: Postuler : mode d'emploi | Toulouse Mairie Métropole
sources.supports: Retrieved general application-process page, distinct from a specific live vacancy; no legal rules generalized from it.

best_entry_page.primary_query: offres communication CDD Toulouse secteur public association
best_entry_page.promise: Find covered public-interest employers and inspect actual vacancies, recruitment wording, required documents and source dates.
best_entry_page.cta: Search fixed-term communications roles and follow covered local employers.
proof_needed: Coverage of public institutions and associations
Actual vacancy versus evergreen advice/PDF classification
Source-linked deadline, duration and process details
Flag conflicting dates rather than silently resolving them

conversion_objections: Are public institutions and small associations covered?
A CDD can still have a specific recruitment route.
I do not want another guide to passing exams.
A visible Apply button may remain after the deadline.
Conflicting dates make me distrust extracted fields.

avoid_targeting.reason: Exam preparation is a different intent.
Civil-service legal guidance is outside the vacancy-discovery promise.

message_to_founder: Simulation: Je veux une offre précise à laquelle je peux répondre, avec la durée, la procédure et les pièces demandées. Ne me renvoyez pas vers une page générale sur les concours, et signalez quand la date limite est passée ou que l'annonce se contredit.

confidence_and_limits: Synthetic simulation, not an interview or an independent respondent. Two queries retrieved on 2026-09-28, with at least one direct page inspection. Queries without observed source IDs are hypotheses. Combined retrieval is not a controlled ranking report. No volume, difficulty or conversion inference. Source claims and role availability can change; product fit uses the supplied repository brief.
